title: Equivariant Chinese remainder equivalence for Gamma0 cosets
statement: Let m,n be nonzero natural numbers with gcd(m,n)=1. Put G=SL₂(ℤ), H_k=Γ₀(k)={A∈G : k divides A₁₀}, and Q_k=G/H_k, the left-coset space with its left G-action. Equip Q_m×Q_n with the diagonal G-action. There exists an equivalence e:Q_(mn)≃Q_m×Q_n such that e(g·q)=g·e(q) for every g∈G and q∈Q_(mn).
lean_statement: ∀ (m n : ℕ) [NeZero m] [NeZero n], Nat.Coprime m n → let G := Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ; let Q := fun k : ℕ => G ⧸ CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 k; ∃ e : Q (m * n) ≃ (Q m × Q n), ∀ (g : G) (q : Q (m * n)), e (g • q) = g • e q
